prompt:
Warm painterly storybook illustration matching the soft flat shading, brushwork, gentle light and palette of the reference image (olive and forest green, warm wood, turmeric orange, steel grey, cream). People are drawn in the same simple storybook style with soft, friendly, lightly detailed faces. No text, no lettering, no logos, no brand marks, no readable screens. Wide landscape composition.
A front view of a cream-coloured fridge door in a warm Indian home kitchen, filling the centre of the frame. The middle 70% of the door is completely empty and smooth, nothing on it, reserved for a paper planner. Around its edges only: a few colourful fruit and vegetable fridge magnets, a small potted plant on the counter beside the fridge, a steel tiffin on the counter, hanging steel ladles on the wall to the left, warm morning light from the side.
